BiblicalUsage: Mâshâl is Mashal, a town given to the Levites out of the tribe of Asher, named once, in 1 Chronicles 6:74. There Mashal with her suburbs is listed among the cities of the Gershonites. The name is a town and a provision.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mâshâl shows me that God gives His servants towns to live in, and that a Levitical city is a provision, not an accident.
